items.followUp: State the head-to-tail rule for adding three vectors.

rubric.why: The rule requires consecutive placement of the vectors.
rubric.description: Places each next vector’s tail at the preceding vector’s head.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating the head-to-tail arrangement.

rubric.why: The resultant joins the start of the first vector to the end of the last.
rubric.description: Identifies how to draw the resultant.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for giving the resultant’s endpoints.

modelAnswer: Place the tail of the next vector at the head of the preceding vector.
Draw the resultant from the tail of the first vector to the head of the last vector.
